# Genuine schema-3 preparation

The archive was generated by the unchanged source at
`49623bad468d41909d7032f87a010cb495cac663`, extracted with read-only `git archive`
into ignored worktree scratch. The original synchronous `prepare_run` sealed a
full-capture, two-item V2 mock/synthetic run with cache OFF. Nothing was submitted.
`schema3-store.json` records source/tree and archive hashes. No schema number,
checksum, manifest, or historical payload was patched. Tests independently retain
the existing nonempty schema-1/2 fixtures and their assertions.

The fixture's original source locations need not exist. Opening the relocated
full snapshot uses the existing explicit `use_frozen_snapshot=True` permission.
